fields.v: No (0): 'repeated trials' is mentioned only conditionally in the aggregation rule; the number of trials per configuration is not stated, and no variance or statistical tests are reported
fields.quote: For repeated trials of the same task instance, we first compute its mean RPR, so each task instance contributes equally regardless of its rubric count.
fields.why: The paper never states that more than one trial was run nor how many, and reports no variance or tests, so under the missing-information rule Q8 may be No rather than Partly.
fields.doubt: O artigo só diz 'para ensaios repetidos... calculamos a média' (pág. 9), sem dizer quantos ensaios houve nem se houve mais do que um, e não há variância nem testes. Pela regra 'informação em falta = Não', decide se Q8 fica Parcial ou Não.
